items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Sy Oliver in the context of Zack Whyte's band, and the interviewee confirms Vic Dickenson and Sy Oliver were with that band, but the interviewee does not describe a personal or professional relationship with Sy Oliver himself.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, loved it. Loved it. Benny Moton, Chick Webb, they were the best bands. Of course Zack Whyte had a good band then. I think Vic Dickenson was with Zack Whyte at the time, Vic Dickenson and Sy.
